items.raw_excerpt: 当大模型从实验室、Demo 和单点工具真正走向企业生产系统，企业对 AI 的态度正在变得矛盾：一方面，没人想错过大模型带来的效率窗口；另一方面，AI 一旦进入研发、客服、营销、办公、运维和业务流程，Token 消耗就会变成一笔越来越难忽视、也越来越难管理的账。

title_i18n.zh: 买了卡不等于买到生产力：企业 Token 焦虑，逼出 AI Infra 新战场
title_i18n.en: Buying cards does not equal buying productivity: Corporate token anxiety drives a new battlefield in AI infrastructure.
title_i18n.es: Comprar tarjetas no equivale a comprar productividad: la ansiedad empresarial por los tokens impulsa un nuevo campo de batalla en la infraestructura de IA.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 当大模型从实验室、Demo 和单点工具真正走向企业生产系统，企业对 AI 的态度正在变得矛盾：一方面，没人想错过大模型带来的效率窗口；另一方面，AI 一旦进入研发、客服、营销、办公、运维和业务流程，Token 消耗就会变成一笔越来越难忽视、也越来越难管理的账。
excerpt_i18n.en: As large models move from labs, demos, and standalone tools into enterprise production systems, companies are developing a conflicted attitude toward AI: on one hand, no one wants to miss the efficiency window brought by large models; on the other, once AI is integrated into R&D, customer service, marketing, office operations, and business processes, token consumption becomes an increasingly unavoidable and harder-to-manage cost.
excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando los grandes modelos pasan de laboratorios, demostraciones y herramientas puntuales a sistemas de producción empresarial, la actitud de las empresas hacia la IA se vuelve contradictoria: por un lado, nadie quiere perder la ventana de eficiencia que ofrecen los grandes modelos; por otro, una vez que la IA entra en I+D, atención al cliente, marketing, oficina, operaciones y procesos de negocio, el consumo de tokens se convierte en una cuenta cada vez más difícil de ignorar y de gestionar.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Lei Feng exclusively learned that embodied intelligence startup AtomBite.AI has recently completed a multi-million yuan seed round of financing. This round was led by Inno Science and Technology Innovation Fund, with follow-on investments from Tsinghua SEM Alumni Seed Fund and well-known individual investors. The funds will primarily be used for developing embodied world models for dining scenarios, refining core products, and deployment. AtomBite.AI was registered and established in Suzhou at the end of March this year, completing its first financing round in less than two months, and has already secured product collaboration and deployment intentions from leading domestic and international companies. The core team includes R&D leaders and top talents from prestigious universities and tech companies such as Tsinghua University, USTC, Meituan, and Horizon Robotics, boasting a strong team background.

01 Tsinghua PhD + Meituan R&D Team

AtomBite.AI founder and CEO Dr. Wang Dong studied under China's AI pioneer, Academician Zhang Bo of Tsinghua University, with over a decade of experience in AI, combining algorithm research and commercial application. Academically, Dr. Wang focused on AI representation issues during his PhD and consistently published high-level papers at top AI and robotics conferences. In 2011, he built the world's first commercial video facial recognition and tracking system; later, he developed industry-leading local life service recommendation systems and mobile native advertising platforms, deeply integrating cutting-edge AI with complex commercial scenarios. Co-founder Li Tao previously led Meituan's food delivery algorithm and data systems.
excerpt_i18n.es: Lei Feng Net ha sabido en exclusiva que la startup de inteligencia encarnada "AtomBite.AI" ha completado recientemente una ronda de financiación semilla de varios millones de yuanes. Según se informa, los fondos se destinarán principalmente al desarrollo de un modelo de mundo encarnado para el sector de la restauración, el perfeccionamiento del producto principal y su implementación. AtomBite.AI se registró y fundó en Suzhou a finales de marzo de este año, y en menos de dos meses completó su primera ronda de financiación, además de haber obtenido intenciones de colaboración y despliegue de productos de varias empresas líderes nacionales e internacionales. Se sabe que el equipo central de la empresa está formado por profesionales de universidades y empresas tecnológicas de primer nivel como Tsinghua, la Universidad de Ciencia y Tecnología de China, Meituan y Horizon Robotics.

excerpt_i18n.en:
"Please pick up the cup." This instruction is effortless for you. You see the cup, understand the meaning of "pick up," and your hand naturally reaches out, grasps, and lifts it. But for an AI system, this involves several nearly insurmountable gaps: from language to action, action to vision, vision to space, and space to execution. Traditional approaches force models to learn direct mappings by inputting text or a set of action parameters, outputting pixel-level video frames or joint angles. This method barely works in constrained environments with sufficient labeled data, but when faced with the complexity of the real world, the system collapses because the gaps are too wide—directly bridging them is doomed to fail. 

The team led by Zhao Hao at the Institute for AI Industry Research, Tsinghua University, published four papers at CVPR 2026, all sharing the same design philosophy: when the gap between two modalities is too large, the real solution is to build a bridge—finding a "third language." This "third language" is the intermediate representation. These four papers validate the same core hypothesis from four different perspectives: from action to video, image to 4D scene, first frame to future video, and heterogeneous hardware to unified policy. Introducing an appropriate intermediate representation is more effective than forcing the model to learn direct mappings.

01 ORV: When a robot watches a video, what does it see? In the field of robot learning, there is a seemingly simple yet long-standing unresolved problem: how to enable robots to learn new skills by watching videos of human operations? The difficulty of this problem far exceeds imagination.
excerpt_i18n.es: "Por favor, levanta la taza". Esta frase te resulta sencilla. Porque ves la taza, entiendes el significado de "levantar", y tu mano se extiende de forma natural, la agarra y la eleva. Pero para un sistema de IA, entre medias hay varias brechas casi insalvables: del lenguaje a la acción, de la acción a la visión, de la visión al espacio, del espacio a la ejecución. El enfoque tradicional obliga al modelo a aprender un mapeo directo, introduciendo un texto o un conjunto de parámetros de acción para que genere directamente fotogramas a nivel de píxel o ángulos articulares. Este método es apenas viable en entornos controlados y con datos etiquetados suficientes, pero al enfrentarse a la complejidad del mundo real, el sistema colapsa, porque la brecha es demasiado amplia y cruzarla directamente está condenado al fracaso.

excerpt_i18n.en: If you have attended cloud-related summits for several consecutive years, you will notice a clear shift this year: the topics have changed. In the past, when we talked about cloud, what were we discussing? Initially, it was about how to migrate servers to the cloud. Later, it shifted to running AI on the cloud—buying GPUs, tuning models, and building inference services. You might still recall that around this time last year, the focus was on which cloud provider offered the cheapest GPUs, how low the model inference latency was, and whether computing power supply was sufficient. But this year, the industry's questions have completely transformed. A major change in the cloud computing industry this year is that everyone has started discussing how to enable agents to autonomously use the cloud. On May 20th, in Hangzhou, Leiphone.com participated in the Alibaba Cloud Summit and observed that Alibaba Cloud had put this issue on the table, providing a systematic answer. From launching the super node server equipped with the self-developed chip Zhenwu M890, releasing the top domestic flagship model Qwen3.7-Max, upgrading the Bailian inference platform, to introducing over 100 cloud product Skills, building agent-native infrastructure, and rewriting the cloud entry point, Alibaba Cloud is thoroughly rebuilding the entire infrastructure from chips to entry points for agents. Notably, just last week, Alibaba's financial report revealed that AI revenue had achieved triple-digit growth for 11 consecutive quarters, and the Bailian platform's ARR exceeded 8 billion yuan. On the day of the announcement, Alibaba's stock price surged by 8%. According to a cloud computing industry insider, "Alibaba Cloud holds the largest share in the MaaS market for large models."

Más tarde, hablábamos de cómo ejecutar IA en la nube, comprar GPU, ajustar modelos y configurar servicios de inferencia. Quizás aún recuerdes que el año pasado por estas fechas, el foco estaba en qué GPU de la nube era más barata, la latencia de inferencia de los modelos y si la capacidad de cómputo era suficiente. Pero este año, los problemas del sector han cambiado por completo. excerpt_i18n.en: A complete AI shopping loop has emerged. On May 11, Qwen fully integrated with Taobao. ChatGPT and Gemini have successively integrated with retailers like Walmart, Amazon developed Rufus in-house, and Microsoft partnered with Stripe. On the other hand, OpenAI, the first to enter the field, quietly scaled back Instant Checkout in early 2026, abandoning the core function of completing transactions directly within the chat interface. One is large model companies integrating with external e-commerce platforms, represented by OpenAI+Shopify and Google+Walmart. excerpt_i18n.es: Un ciclo completo de compras con IA ha tomado forma. El 11 de mayo, Qianwen se integró completamente con Taobao. Los usuarios pueden abrir la aplicación Qianwen, conversar con la IA y completar la selección, comparación y compra de productos en Taobao. Dentro de Taobao, también se puede experimentar la compra con IA haciendo clic en "Asistente de compras con IA Qianwen". El debate sobre cómo la IA está remodelando el comercio electrónico lleva dos años, pero el panorama futuro sigue sin estar claro. Por un lado, los gigantes tecnológicos globales están haciendo movimientos. items.title: 抖音“前沿科技首发计划”启动，首站落地Google I/O 2026大会
items.raw_excerpt: 当地时间5月19日，一年一度的Google I/O大会在美国加利福尼亚州举行。大会以主题演讲和分论坛等形式，展示谷歌各项前沿技术的最新进展。抖音作为Google I/O 2026中国区“首席内容合作平台”，邀请12位科技创作者亲临大会现场，以第一视角记录并解读现场发布的的最新前沿科技信息，让科技爱好者同步感知全球最新技术动态。相关内容将于近期在抖音独家上线，用户登录抖音或抖音精选App，搜索“前沿科技首发计划”，即可了解详细内容。 本次大会谷歌将展示在AI创新领域的最新进展以及针对开发者的工具与解决方案，通过与抖音的内容合作，国内的科技爱好者和开发者也将及时获取现场发布的最新信息。 此外，AI（人工智能）、Android、Chrome 和 Cloud（云计算）领域也将有重大更新。在人人都是潜在开发者的AI时代，抖音作为 2026 Google I/O 大会 中国区“首席内容合作平台” ，将新技术触达给更广泛的科技与AI爱好者，也让更多创新技术被关注。 12位抖音科技创作者亲临大会第一现场，体验最新的科技，用视频记录一手信息，并以创作者视角进行创意解读。创作者们还将与全球参会嘉宾及谷歌团队深度对话。此外，多位创作者还将基于Google AI开发趣味工具与创意玩法，并在会场与世界科技爱好者互动，拉近大众与前沿科技的距离。   据悉，本次和Google I/O 2026大会合作，是抖音“前沿科技首发计划”落地的首站。2026年，抖音科技发起“前沿科技首发计划”。相关负责人介绍，抖音将通过该计划持续联动前沿产业资源，引入科技行业关键人物，扶持优质内容创作，为创作者提供更多稀缺前沿科技场景，让用户第一时间走进科技现场，感知全球最新科技趋势演进。截至目前，已有数家顶尖企业、高新实验室陆续加入计划中。   近年来，凭借科技内容生态优势，抖音成为越来越多科技前沿趋势讨论

The conference featured keynote speeches and breakout sessions to showcase the latest advancements in Google's cutting-edge technologies. As the "Chief Content Cooperation Platform" for Google I/O 2026 in China, Douyin invited 12 tech creators to the event to document and interpret the latest frontier tech announcements from a first-person perspective, allowing tech enthusiasts to stay updated on global tech trends. Through content collaboration with Douyin, domestic tech enthusiasts and developers will also gain timely access to the latest information released on-site. In the AI era where everyone is a potential developer, Douyin, as the "Chief Content Cooperation Platform" for Google I/O 2026 in China, brings new technologies to a broader audience of tech and AI enthusiasts, drawing attention to more innovative technologies. The 12 Douyin tech creators experienced the latest technologies firsthand at the event, recorded primary information through videos, and provided creative interpretations from a creator's perspective. They also engaged with global attendees and the Google team.
